fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are the JSON-LD NewsArticle object spread verbatim. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) come from the default site-wide RSS 2.0 feed, which carries only title/description/link/guid/pubDate -- no byline field. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, if carried in the JSON-LD block.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object(s) as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
